sentences.text: Eosqualiolus is an extinct genus of sharks belonging to the class Chondrichthyes and the family Dalatiidae.
The genus was first described by Sylvain Adnet in 2006.
The species E. skrovinai was identified based on 14 fossil teeth discovered in the Laksarska Nova Ves Formation.
Fossils of this shark date from the Lutetian to the Burdigalian stages, between 48.07 and 15.98 million years ago.
The type species, E. aturensis, lived during the middle Eocene in what is now France.
Another species, E. skrovinai, was described from fossils found in Slovakia during the Miocene.
